description: Session manager: while managing is on (the `manage` skill), add every new or resumed Claude Code session to the saved list and drop the ones exited on purpose. Does nothing (exits at once) while managing is off.

hooks.command: [ -f "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/tracking" ] || exit 0; case "$(uname -s)" in MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/sessions.ps1" track -DataDir "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA" ;; *) python3 "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/sessions.py" track -DataDir "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA" ;; esac >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0

[ -f "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/tracking" ] || exit 0; case "$(uname -s)" in MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/sessions.ps1" track -DataDir "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA" ;; *) python3 "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/sessions.py" track -DataDir "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA" ;; esac >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
